title: Identify the product descriptions purchased by SME customers who paid more
question: Identify the product descriptions purchased by SME customers who paid more than 25.00 per unit in transactions at gas stations located in the Czech Republic, and who also had a consumption decrease from 2012 to 2013.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_009
FROM customers C
JOIN transactions_1k T ON C.XCL_001 = T.XCL_013
JOIN products P ON T.XCL_016 = P.XCL_008
JOIN gasstations G ON T.XCL_015 = G.XCL_004
JOIN (
    SELECT Y.XCL_019
    FROM yearmonth Y
    WHERE SUBSTR(Y.XCL_020, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY Y.XCL_019
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END)
) AS Dec ON C.XCL_001 = Dec.XCL_019
WHERE C.XCL_002 = 'SME'
  AND G.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
  AND T.XCL_018 / T.XCL_017 > 25.00
